SELECT cls, fish_date_doy, SUM(yt) yt, SUM(anglers) anglers, ROUND(SUM(yt)/SUM(anglers),3) ypa, COUNT(*) n
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 165 AND 180
GROUP BY cls, fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls

SELECT cls, SUM(yt) yt, SUM(anglers) anglers, ROUND(SUM(yt)/SUM(anglers),3) ypa, COUNT(*) n
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=2 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 183 AND 213
GROUP BY cls
ORDER BY ypa DESC
